about_the_game:
You are a homunculus, created by the Alchemist.

You wake up with one clear mission: find the stone. A stone with incredible power. But why? What makes it so important? Why were you chosen for this task? And most importantly... are you alone on this journey? Whether you face it alone or with friends, the path ahead is full of danger and mystery…

Your adventure unfolds across various locations, each revealing fragments of the Alchemist’s past and the truth about your existence. Visit forgotten villages and an ancient monasteries, each step bringing you closer to understanding—but also deeper into mystery. As you explore, you stumble upon a book filled with old, incomplete potion recipes, granting you incredible powers; push and pull objects from afar, summon fire, freeze time, or even decay what stands in your way. The more you learn, the stronger you become—but magic always comes at a price!

Will your soul survive this journey? And what of the Alchemist—was he a savior, a monster, or something far more dangerous?
